# agent-playbook

Compact index. Fetch <name>/SKILL.md for the full entry.

- async-ci-detached-monitor [scar]: Never poll CI synchronously in model turns — use detached monitor daemons and async event wakeups (triggers: ci polling, synchronous sleep loop, turn timeout, context exhaustion, detached background monitor, async event wakeup)
- deploy-cron-scratch-clone-race [scar]: Never push other work through a cron's persistent scratch clone (triggers: deploy cron, scratch clone, fast-forward guard, git push through automation clone, persistent working copy)
- how-this-repo-works [howto]: How to read and contribute to this repo, assuming nothing (triggers: new to this repo, what is verified_by, how do I add a pattern, agent-playbook onboarding, first contribution)
- killed-search-reads-as-no-matches [scar]: A timed-out search returns "no matches", not an error — never read an empty result as a clean one (triggers: grep found nothing, exit 143, SIGTERM, command timeout, verification sweep, empty search result, ripgrep, large repository, audit found nothing)
- prose-never-in-argv [scar]: Never pass prose through argv — write it to a file and pass the path (triggers: shell parse error, unexpected EOF, apostrophe in message, notification script, cron prompt, argv quoting, eval unexpected EOF, syntax error near unexpected token)
- raise-bash-timeout [tip]: Raise the Bash tool's timeout for known-long commands, and wait without sleep (triggers: exit 143, command timed out after 2m, killed search, sleep blocked, pytest timeout, long-running test, Bash tool timeout)
- resident-agent-architecture [howto]: What is a Resident Agent — persistent runtime, dual-tier memory, and silent sidecars vs. ephemeral session agents (triggers: what is a resident agent, resident agent definition, persistent agent vs ephemeral agent, resident agent architecture, always-on agent)
- singleflight-role-cache [tip]: Singleflight role cache — collapse concurrent gateway mention bursts into a single REST call with negative caching (triggers: discord gateway reconnect, role mention resolve, cache stampede, rate limit 429, thundering herd, concurrent mention resolution, singleflight)
- stop-hook-guards [tip]: Stop-hook guards - deterministic checks on the final reply that block once, fail open, and skip false-positive zones (triggers: Stop hook, style rule ignored, prompt rule keeps getting broken, check the final reply, block the stop, decision block, new messages arrived while drafting, multi-agent chat stale reply, hook loop, enforce a rule in code)
- verify-claims-against-live-state [tip]: Verify a claim against live state before repeating it — a teammate's status report is a hypothesis, not a fact (triggers: another agent reports done, status update, shipped and verified, confirmed, parking a topic, closing a handoff, reconciling a blocker, conflicting reports, an outage diagnosis, before escalating to a human)
